previous_experiences: Contributed to SpatialLM, NeurIPS 2025 publication on structured indoor modeling
Led development of SpatialGen, 3DV 2026 publication on layout-guided 3D scene generation

bio_text: Anthony Zhao is Head of North America at SpatialVerse (Manycore Tech), leading spatial intelligence research and development. With deep expertise in 3D reconstruction, computer vision, and scene understanding, he drives cutting-edge work in AI-powered 3D modeling and layout generation for indoor environments.
